scenarios.title: Diagnose the machine and lock the engine series
Initialize a project, and re-run the initialization
Accept a bundle published by fluidblend
Wrap a third-party GLB into a bundle
Import a bundle into Unreal and publish it as a version
notes: 188 deform bones, one animation, published as v001 in 21.62s; the importer's proxy root and its extra assets are reported, not claimed away

scenarios.title: Audit the imported asset: scale, axes, length, root motion
notes: five reference bones within a millimetre, 188 deform bones, 47 frames against 48; the walk declared in place travels 57.5 cm over 75 top bones, and the audit fails it for that

scenarios.title: Play the character headless in the test bed and report 14 checks
notes: 14 checks measured and passed; the clip wrapped 1 time(s), the distance between the feet varied by 9.5 cm, the prop stayed on the hand over 200 cm

scenarios.title: Render one frame off-screen and measure the share the character covers
notes: the character and its shadow cover 2.08% of a 640x360 frame, in one region [191, 77, 401, 344]; the frames were opened and looked at when this scenario was written (docs/reviews)

scenarios.title: Replay an operation_id, and refuse it with other parameters
notes: asset.import replayed: same result, no editor, no task folder, no revision, no version; journal `replayed`. replace_existing under the same id -> exit 3; bundle.accept likewise

scenarios.title: Supply an escaping path or a command as a parameter
notes: 13 requests refused before execution: 9 paths -> PERMISSION_REQUIRED (exit 2), 4 identifiers -> VALIDATION_FAILED (exit 4); no task folder, no task event

scenarios.title: Refuse a run over its time or disk budget before anything starts
notes: 720 s estimated (nothing measured: stated defaults) over max_task_minutes=1 -> exit 6; 32 MiB needed on a drive with 5 MiB free -> exit 6; 32 MiB over max_new_disk_gib=0.01 -> exit 6; no task folder, no task event, no editor

scenarios.title: Kill the editor mid-import: unknown, refused, reconciled, nothing published
notes: editor killed with a staging folder on disk: exit 5, retry refused, reconcile removed the staging and published nothing, the retry then imported v001

scenarios.title: Hand a fix back to fluidblend as a request it accepts
notes: four templates, each validated by fluidblend's own validate_request

scenarios.title: Blender to Unreal and back: export, import, audit, play, shoot, re-export
notes: fluidblend baked and exported; accepted, imported, audited (technical pass), played (14 checks) and shot; the reexport_unreal request ran in fluidblend as written and its bundle was accepted
